items.name: Treasury quarterly refunding statement (Q4 2026) - statement text read
items.source: US Treasury press release sb0678 (Quarterly Refunding Statement, dated 2026-11-04)
items.refunding_size: USD 125bn offered; refunds ~USD 97bn of privately held notes/bonds maturing 2026-11-15; ~USD 28bn new cash

coupon_sizes.tips: Nov 10y reopening 19bn; Dec 5y reopening 24bn; Jan 10y new issue 21bn

items.guidance: Treasury says it anticipates keeping nominal coupon and FRN auction sizes unchanged for the next several quarters (no 'at least' qualifier in the sentence as read). Bills: benchmark sizes held into late November with a possible short-dated CMB around month-end, cuts to shorter-dated bills in December ahead of the mid-December tax date, increases across the bill curve in January. 7-year note converts to a quarterly new issue with two reopenings starting with the March 2027 new issue. Cash balance assumption USD 850bn at end-December; TGA could peak near USD 1.025tn (+/- 50bn) in late November and late January. Buybacks: up to USD 70bn liquidity support, up to USD 25bn cash-management in the 1-month to 2-year bucket.
items.note: as_of = statement publication date; text read today 2026-11-06 on home.treasury.gov (yesterday's fetch had failed). Confirms yesterday's press-sourced sizes (58/42/25, 125 total, 97 refunding, 28 new cash) and buyback caps. DISCREPANCY vs 11-05 file: yesterday's item recorded 'next release listed as 2027-01-15' (from the refunding-documents landing page); the statement text gives the next quarterly refunding announcement as Wednesday 2027-02-03 - these may be different events (financing estimates vs refunding), not re-checked on the landing page today.
